selector.rationale: The patient has a trace positive sputum GeneXpert for MTB, subsequent MTB growth sensitive to rifampicin and isoniazid, and biopsy of the toe ulcer showed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus, which strongly supports pulmonary tuberculosis.

rejected.label: Renal tuberculosis
rejected.why: Despite some evidence of renal involvement, the primary diagnosis of pulmonary tuberculosis explains the majority of symptoms and findings, including the positive sputum and biopsy results.

rejected.label: Chronic kidney disease
rejected.why: While the patient has some renal abnormalities, they are more likely secondary to the primary diagnosis rather than a standalone chronic kidney disease.

rejected.label: Pott's disease
rejected.why: Although the patient has spinal involvement, it is more likely a complication of the primary pulmonary tuberculosis rather than a standalone Pott's disease.
